working_definition: Numbered spermatocyte cluster 5 of the adult testis, a transcriptional state along the primary spermatocyte stage; authors' term FBbt:00004936 spermatocyte.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Male germline cell that is part of the 16-cell spermatocyte cyst. It expresses twine, which regulates the meiotic cycle (Witt et al., 2019).

justification: Authors' FBbt id kept (not obsolete, cell term, no adult variant). Numbered stage bin with no specific FBbt term, so the cell type is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Male germ cells of the 16-cell cyst from the end of the S-phase that precedes meiosis I to the end of meiosis I.
